title: Been weekending this FPS engine for a while. Inspired by and can run various maps from millenium era games.
author: ztifff
selftext:
Would probably be more fun with some other people in the room. In theory it should support 32 players, but I've more or less kept it a secret until today. Want to see if we can break it? Join it on [https://distantfront.io](https://distantfront.io)

Built with various agents on React Three Fiber with Three.js's WebGPU renderer and TSL shaders. Its server is Node with Colyseus rooms and a hand-packed binary protocol, SQLite for accounts, and Cloudflare in front of a Docker container.
